recipes.name: Cheeseburger Soft Tacos
ingredients_raw: 2 leaves green leaf lettuce, small leaves
1 large red onion, 1/4-inch slices pulled into rings

steps.text: Divide beef into 4 equal parts; form each part into a thin half-moon-shaped patty, shaped to fill half a tortilla. Season patties with salt and black pepper.

Heat a 10-inch, nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add patties; cook to your desired doneness, about 3 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
Top each patty with ¼ cheese towards end of cooking time; cook until cheese melts. Transfer cheeseburgers to a plate; keep warm.
Warm tortillas in a microwave for 10 seconds.

Place 1 cheeseburger on one half 1 tortilla; top with 1 tomato slice, 1 lettuce leaf, onion rings, and 3 pickle slices. Fold tortilla in half. Repeat with remaining 3 cheeseburgers, tortillas, tomato slices, lettuce leaves, onion rings, and pickle slices.

raw_recipe.headline: Cheeseburger Soft Tacos
raw_recipe.description: This cheeseburger soft taco recipe is a creative spin on the typical cheeseburger, combining all the flavors you love wrapped in a soft taco shell.

review.reviewBody: I wrap them like a burrito then lightly mist with olive olive, place on the foreman and lightly "toast".

This is a good little cheeseburger. It was quick and easy to get this on the table. I put barbecue sauce on mine, but any condiment or burger topping would work. This isn't really a taco as there is no taco seasoning, no mexican spices, salsa or sour cream, but it is a cheeseburger wrap. Great when you don't have buns and don't want to use sandwich bread. I shaped the burgers into half moons but they shrunk way up when cooking. The next time I will make larger round burgers, cook them, and then cut them in half moons. It would be easier and take less time than fiddling with those smaller patties. We liked this presentation and we'll have this again.

I made two versions of this tonight; one with ground sirloin (and 3 dashes worcestershire sauce and a sprinkle of seasonsed salt with kraft singles to melt quickly, and the other version was ground turkey with some creole seasoning and swiss cheese. Both got thumbs up!
Kids really liked these. This was a quick weeknight meal. Fast and good.
When I do these, I add taco seasoning to the raw ground beef before I make it into patties. My family loves it.
These were really good and easy to make! The kids loved them too!
A great way to have a burger and cut down on carbs. It could also be changed up by using some of the other flavors of tortillas.
Tasty, rather have a burger in a BUN!
This was an interesting way to have hamburgers and my family really liked them. Nice change of pace from buns.

This was a very good twist to the same old everyday taco. I would eat this many times again. My daughter loves sour cream on regular tacos and loved it on this also. i also prepared the burger with onions and seasoning before I cooked it.
